fields.label: Divisions
fields.note: Vue dropdown filters client-side on the board row's Division metadata; no server parameter.

fields.label: Offices
fields.note: Vue dropdown filters client-side on offices[].name and the location prefix; offices come from /v1/boards/flowtraders/offices.

notes: https://www.flowtraders.com/careers/ links to /careers/job-search/, whose Vue app fetches the company-published Greenhouse board https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/flowtraders/jobs?content=true&per_page=500 plus the offices feed in one request each. The page markup has a free-term keyword input, Divisions and Offices dropdowns and a Search button; filter(), showMoreJobs() and filteredJobs show keyword/division/office matching and 10-row "show more" slicing are all client-side over the single 500-row array. No server-side filter parameters exist.
